title: The Silhouette Operator: Identifiability of Low-Rank Measures from One-Dimensional Projections
summary: Structured recovery phenomena, such as restricted isometry properties in compressed sensing, have shown that high-dimensional objects can often be reconstructed from remarkably low-dimensional linear measurements. This work develops an analogous recovery framework for low-rank signed measures on $\mathbb{R}^2$, defined here as measures that can be expressed as finite sums of product measures with one-dimensional factors.
